parameters.name: ApplyId
parameters.description: The application batch ID to query. You can view the application batch ID in the response of the [BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~) or [BatchRegisterDevice](~~69473~~) operation.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the invoke failed.

> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
